call_points.text: Exports were about ₹50 Cr, nearly the whole of last year's export value, led by fibre and power cables to the US and Europe.
Electrical cable margins are about 10.5% and management calls them sustainable.
Germanium tetrachloride supply is hand to mouth; the company has enough for the calendar year with more on the way.
Management declined to quantify data centre order prospects or long-term customer contracts.
Sachin Naik joined as CFO effective 1 June 2026.
Management declined to give FY27 revenue or margin guidance, citing Middle East volatility.
Fibre draw capacity to double from 4 mn km to 8 mn km by July/August 2026.
Communication cable volume growth was about 7% in FY26.
Electrical segment Q4 revenue ₹1,697 Cr, up 22% YoY; FY26 up 22%.
Communication cable EBIT margin was about 6% in FY26; management expects improvement but gave no number.
Preform is expected to be 5-10% better than market cost once stabilised.
Germanium supply from China and Europe is constrained; inventory covers a few months.
Retail wire demand hit by copper price rises; retail-to-project mix shifted to two-thirds/one-third.

operating_notes.text: Electrical capacity utilisation about 66%, with 15% headroom at current prices.
Communication cable volume growth about 7% in FY26; revenue flat at about ₹500 Cr.
EHV JV order book about ₹380 Cr; key machinery utilisation above 80%.
Standard fibre G.652.D settled at USD 12-13 per km in Q1FY27, down from USD 17-18 but above USD 5-6 in December 2025.
Preform capacity of 100 tonnes covers about 4 million km of fibre, half of the planned 8 million km draw capacity.
Electrical cable mix is about 60% construction, with auto, agriculture and industrials at 10-12% each and solar smaller; auto cables were over 14% this quarter.
